blocker: The agent stopped prematurely after inspecting git history without actually finding or merging the changes into master.
narrative: The agent explored the git repository using git status, git branch -a, and git log, identified commits on another branch or state, but then immediately set task_complete to true without performing any git merge or checkout commands.
verifier_evidence: The verifier failed because the changes were never merged into the master branch.
needed_instead: The agent needed to checkout the branch containing the changes and merge them into the master branch before declaring the task complete.
